All Decked Out | WaterColor

1942 E County Highway 30A, Santa Rosa Beach, FL 32459

‘All Decked Out' exemplifies what it means to vacation in a luxurious WaterColor home! This home was completely renovated in 2019 with no detail overlooked and creates the foundation for a family vacation you will not forget.

This highway 30A, gulf front view property is a stunning three story, 5 bedroom home located in the Gulf District of WaterColor. This professionally decorated home offers elegance and comfort at the beach! The first floor gives way to a large living area equipped with a shuffle board and game table that is perfect for family game night. A previous screened in porch was converted into a spacious laundry and sand room that offers convenience and efficiency with the double stacked washer and dryer and an ice maker. The first bedroom on this floor is a king suite with a private bathroom with a single vanity and walk-in shower. The next bedroom offers two twin singles with a private bathroom featuring a walk-in shower. The last bedroom has two twin over twin bunk beds and a private bathroom with a walk-in shower. There is also a half bathroom on this floor for convenience.

On the second floor, you will find a spacious, gourmet kitchen with top of the line stainless steel appliances, a second living room, and one of the two master bedrooms. The kitchen is complete with a wine cooler, refrigerator and freezer, and range stovetop and oven. There is bar stool seating around the center island for 4 guests and the dining room table can accommodate 8 guests. The living room provides a comfortable setting for relaxing together with plenty of stylish seating. There are balconies to the front and to the back of this house; the front balcony offers a porch swing that is perfect for afternoon naps and the back balcony boasts beautiful gulf views and outdoor dining table for 6 guests. The master bedroom has a king sized bed and a private bathroom with a walk-in shower.

For the third floor, the second master suite has exceptional gulf views and connects to an oversized master bathroom that has a freestanding tub and large shower with dual shower systems that are complete with body sprays. There is also a washer and dryer in the master bathroom closet. The third floor also features a private media room with a 70'' TV. The balconies on the second and third floors are ideal for an early morning coffee while taking in the sounds and views of the Gulf of Mexico.

Reservation/Booking Policy

- Minimum age: All properties require a minimum of one adult over the age of 26 be staying at the property throughout the rental term.

- A 50% deposit is due at the time of booking.

- Except for a $250 cancelation fee, deposits are fully refundable if cancelations are given 60 days prior to the arrival date.

- Balance of payment is due 60 days prior to the arrival date.

- Check-in begins at 4:00 PM and check-out is by 10:00 AM

- Cleaning: Reservations made for 5 nights require a mid-stay clean. This will be added onto your total when checking out.
